text:
samir: Quick heads-up — while running long-context user sessions I saw steady KV cache residency drift on a subset of inference nodes. Thought it might be noise but trace+profile shows correlated evictions.

anya: Which metric are you looking at? raw numbers?

samir: Pasting a short scrape from one of the affected replicas:

```
# prom scrape snippet
kv_cache_hits_total{model="mixer-v2",shard="3"} 124567
kv_cache_misses_total{model="mixer-v2",shard="3"} 58321
kv_cache_evictions_total{model="mixer-v2",shard="3"} 452
kv_cache_residency_ratio{model="mixer-v2",shard="3"} 0.682
kv_cache_fragmentation_ratio{model="mixer-v2",shard="3"} 0.123
kv_cache_resident_bytes{model="mixer-v2",shard="3"} 5.0e+09
```

samir: Over ~8h sessions residency ratio slides from ~0.9 -> 0.68 and evictions spike when sequence lengths drift >8k tokens. Happens after kernel-selection bump last week.

kevin: @samir good catch. We did roll kernel selector v2.1 on 2001100000 (opt-path for long kv chains). Could be kernel change + batching shift exposing fragmented allocations.

anya: Can you add the profiling trace? curious about per-shard pagewalk frequency and whether we see lots of small frees vs big frees (fragmentation).

samir: Attaching a short flame of allocator churn and eviction reasons:

```
evict_reason{type="lru_capacity",count=318}
evict_reason{type="fragmentation",count=127}
evict_reason{type="ttl",count=6}
alloc_size_histogram_buckets: 64,256,1024,8192,65536
most churn at 1k-8k range
```

kevin: Ok that points to fragmentation-heavy behaviour (many midsize chunks). We should instrument eviction_reason as a Prom counter (per-model, per-shard) + add resident_bytes histogram and an occupancy percentile (p50/90/99).

anya: Also add an eviction_age histogram so we can see if entries live long before eviction (helps differentiate churn vs size pressure).

samir: Agreed. Proposal:
- new counters: kv_cache_eviction_total{reason,model,shard}
- histograms: kv_cache_eviction_age_seconds_bucket, kv_cache_resident_bytes_bucket
- gauge: kv_cache_residency_ratio{model,shard}
- sampling: 1/1000 full key path sampling to capture pagewalk stacks (store in tracing)

kevin: For dashboard panels I'd add:
- Residency time-series per model (heatmap over shards)
- Eviction reason stacked bar (per-hour)
- Resident bytes percentile panel
- Eviction age histogram
- Small alloc churn rate sparkline

anya: Alerts:
- residency_ratio < 0.75 sustained 10m -> P2
- eviction_rate increase > 3x baseline in 5m -> P1
- fragmentation_ratio > 0.2 -> P3

samir: I'll open a PR to add counters and a small agent-side sampler that emits evict_reason and allocation-size on eviction paths. @kevin can you sketch the Grafana panels? I'll wire the alert rules after metrics land.

deploy-bot: NOTE: rolling kernel-selector v2.1 was deployed to us-west-2 on 2001100000.

infra-bot: Can we add a runtime flag to turn on detailed sampling only for a single pool? avoids cluster noise.

kevin: yes — runtime flag `KV_SAMPLE_MODE=per-pool` sounds right. I'll make the dashboard mock and add the queries in a PR.

anya: Owner list: samir -> metrics + sampler PR, kevin -> dashboard mock + alert rules, infra -> toggle flag and rollout guard. Marking follow-up in eng-runtime board.

samir: Thanks — I'll kick off the PR and include a small repro harness to generate long-context sessions so QA can validate.

kevin: If anyone hits this in prod before metrics land, add `--kv-pool-cap=1` to limit resident set temporarily.

anya: :thumbsup:
